_comment: Understood table layouts, emitted field by field by tools/disasm_all.py. Each table: bank, addr (hex CPU address), label (an alias; Data_BBB_AAAA labels are kept), count, id_base (optional; record index + id_base is shown in comments), id_names ("monster" appends the monster name to the id comment), fields (db N bytes | words N bytes shown as little-endian dw values | ptr = 16-bit pointer into the same bank, or into the bank given by the field bank_from indexes; "stream": true registers the target as a compressed stream),, optional record (a short description printed instead of the list of field names), and note. Every layout cites its evidence in docs/EVIDENCE_LOG.md. Field names state only what the evidence supports.

Bytes 22-25 equal the save record's bytes at offsets $6F-$72 for the opening monster (E-0034); the three used by PersonalityIndexOfRecord are the personality axes.
